method: Re-ingest ten existing abstract-only documents (identical content) into the quantum_computing namespace (3,369 chunks), one call per document, after one warm-up ingest; both runs from the same working directory, so they share the local resonance and relation state. Two repetitions each.
note: The default path removes the edge-file reparse (no behaviour change). consolidate='end' skips per-document resonance consolidation and is opt-in because the resonance state then goes through fewer decay cycles.
